pages.title: Gigantopithecus
pages.text: $(o)Gigantopithecus$() ($(o)Gigantopithecus blacki$()) was the largest ape that ever lived, a relative of the orangutans that inhabited the forests of southern China until a few hundred thousand years ago.$(br2)It is known almost entirely from massive jaws and teeth, which suggest an animal perhaps 3 metres tall that fed on fruit and tough plants.$(br2)It probably died out as its forests gave way to more open country that could not feed so large an ape.
